prediction: The decision to inline is based on an incomplete check for side effects, failing to account for property modifications within the function body.
experiment_rationale: The failure is a classic case of an incorrect guard condition (checking for side effects before inlining). The compiler should have checked if the function had side effects and aborted the inlining if it did.
